feature: One dashboard-owned speech collector, authenticated SSE fan-out
direction: Compact, technical, quiet: retain ag's green/neutral theme, metadata rail above plain speech, full-height tail with a single filter/status toolbar; no cards or explanatory subtitle. Read-only request feed, never browser audio playback.

requirements.contract: Start one shared follow_hosts pipeline per ag dash process, including when no browser is open. Reuse ag tts local/SSH readers, cursor reconnect and isolated host failures. Browsers never start another collector.
SSE and snapshot require existing token-cookie and Host checks. No token in stream URLs, permissive CORS, transcript logs or persistent duplicate feed. Render untrusted fields as text.

Ordered epoch-qualified event IDs; atomic snapshot/replay boundary; Last-Event-ID reconnect within retained history; explicit snapshot reset after eviction/restart. Slow browsers cannot backpressure the collector.
Memory bounded by 500 events/2 MiB encoded journal, 16 KiB text per entry, 32 SSE connections, bounded metadata. Explicit truncation/reset. SIGTERM/Ctrl-C closes SSE and cancels/reaps owned tails.

TTS tab: host/kind/text filters, connected/offline/error state, follow tail pauses while reading history, new-message indicator, jump-to-live. Keyboard and narrow/light/dark layouts; bounded batched render updates and no hidden-pane rendering.
Enabled by default in existing ag-dash Home Manager job. CLI/config/HM opt-out and initial-line count; no extra service, microphone, playback or live deployment for testing.

delivery: Nix package and source publication; activation remains operator-owned
